title: Normalized compact-support vector trace in a Cartesian presentation
statement: Use the fixed finite-coefficient setting P [def-pur-diagonal-orientation-refinement-data]. Let B,B′ be Noetherian finite-type k-schemes and F,F′ rank-d locally free modules. For a Cartesian map v:E(F′)→E(F) over b:B′→B preserving zero, put T_X=A_X(d)[2d] in the ordered diagonal-exponent presentation [def-amb-vector-integration-charts]. Let c_f be its normalized finite Tate pullback comparison. The actual trace τ_F:Rπ_!T_E→1_B is Rπ_!(c_π^{-1}) followed by vectorBundleIntegration [def-amb-vector-integration] and the specified singleFunctorObjUnitIso. Define τ_F′ similarly. Then the compact-support exchange on T_E, followed by Rπ′_!(c_v) and τ_F′, equals b*(τ_F) followed by the actual monoidal unit pullback comparison. No linearity is required. This is an equality before transposition or restriction to a section.

proof.text: The composition-unit law for derived inverse image identifies the pullback-unit comparisons around the Cartesian square. Naturality and right unitality of tensor pullback then give the source-unit equation for purityBundleBaseChangeAssociator. Combine that equation with naturality of gamma prime for the base pullback-unit isomorphism and the exceptional exchange equation at the unit. This yields the square for the two Brown adjuncts on the bundle coefficient, with its specified coefficient comparison.

proof.text: Apply the inverse Hom equivalence to the adjunct square. Use mateEquiv_counit and naturality of inverse compact-support exchange to identify the left side with inverse exchange followed by pullback of integration. Cancel inverse exchange. Finally apply orderedTatePullbackSquare around the projection square and naturality of compact-support exchange to replace both bundle-pulled coefficients by the total-space Tate coefficients. This is exactly the displayed equality. No rank, nonemptiness, or positive-level case split is used.

lean.statement:
theorem vector_normalized_trace_cartesian (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (B B' : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian B] [IsNoetherian B']
    (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (aB' : B' ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aB'] [QuasiCompact aB']
    (d : ℕ) (F : B.Modules) (F' : B'.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d] [F'.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (b : B' ⟶ B)
    (v : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B' d F' ⟶ VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F)
    (sq : IsPullback v (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B' d F')
      (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F) b)
    (hz : VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B' d F' ≫ v =
      b ≫ VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F) :
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B d F).1
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B d F).2.1
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B' d F').1
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B' d F').2.1
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F) aB
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B' d F') aB'
    let t := purityTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      (pow_pos P.coefficients.prime.out.pos P.level) P.diagonalExponent_annihilates
    let c (T S : Scheme.{u}) (f : T ⟶ S) (aS : S ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) :=
      Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t f (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aS) d
    let π := VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F
    let π' := VectorBundleZeroSection.π B' d F'
    let L := Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) π
    let L' := Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) π'
    let τ := L.map (c _ _ π aB).inv ≫
      Etale.vectorBundleIntegration P.diagonalExponent
        (pow_pos P.coefficients.prime.out.pos P.level) P.Coefficient
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates B (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aB) d F ≫
      (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) B).hom
    let τ' := L'.map (c _ _ π' aB').inv ≫
      Etale.vectorBundleIntegration P.diagonalExponent
        (pow_pos P.coefficients.prime.out.pos P.level) P.Coefficient
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates B' (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aB') d F' ≫
      (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) B').hom
    (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap P.Coefficient sq).app
        (Etale.affineLinearBaseCoefficient P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
          P.diagonalExponent_annihilates (VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F) d) ≫
      L'.map (c _ _ v (π ≫ aB)).hom ≫ τ' =
    (Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback P.Coefficient b).map τ ≫
      (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) b).hom
